Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.2: Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: How can you ensure you understand what you read? 2. Why is it important to understand the different shades of meaning of words?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: The learner applies their ability to generate new ideas as they discuss shades of meaning in the

narrative (denotative and connotative meanings).

86

● Citizenship: The learner shows tolerance while collaboratively previewing a narrative by examining the title and picture

clues.

Values:
Unity: The learner cooperates with others as they share findings in a whole class discussion.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Life skills- social awareness: The learner communicates effectively when working together to discuss comprehension

strategies.

Suggested Learning Resources

● Print texts

● Braille texts

● Electronic reading materials

● Digital devices with assistive technology

● Audio visual clips

Suggested Skills:

● Bringing out the denotative and connotative meaning of words for comprehension,

● Relating (making connections) information in a text to real life situations,

● Summarizing information from a text for comprehension.
